title: Sprint Entry Gate

sprint_114_readiness.summary: Sprint 114 closed locally on DELAYED; only corrective scope was approved.

approved_scope.summary: Sequential expansion may proceed only inside the locally approved corrective scope.

product_spec.summary: Product scope, placement, delivery rules, provider constraints, and acceptance invariants are recorded.

security_constraints.summary: OAuth PKCE, state/nonce validation, scoped consent, secure storage, reauthentication, redaction, and audit constraints are mandatory.

privacy_constraints.summary: No prompt or creative-content analytics, no secret collection, no fabricated usage or billing data, and explicit cross-workspace consent are required.

provider_feasibility.summary: No provider connector is claimed available before manifest-driven and live verification; feasibility is bounded by fail-closed local rules.

limitations: Entry gate PASS applies only to the approved corrective local scope on the DELAYED path.
Provider, connector, quota, credits, subscription, and payment integrations remain PLANNED until implementation and live verification exist.
The local gate does not claim a public v1.2 release, production health, external adoption, or connector certification.
Hosted CI, public-trust signing, live telemetry, hardware, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
